title: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science - Pre Vocational Studies - Factors of Agricultural Production
exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: In agricultural production, the factor that encompasses all natural resources and the space where farming activities take place is known as ________.
questions.explain: Land as a factor of production refers to the earth's surface and all the free gifts of nature (soil, minerals) used for farming.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: What is the financial reward that accrues to the owner of land used for agricultural purposes?
questions.explain: The economic reward or return given for the use of land in production is called rent.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: The physical and mental effort exerted by human beings to produce agricultural goods is referred to as ________.
questions.explain: Labour represents the human effort, both physical (like tilling) and mental (like planning tasks), directed towards agricultural production.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which factor of agricultural production is essential for purchasing farm inputs such as seeds, fertilizers, and farm implements?
questions.explain: Money (capital) is the financial resource required to buy all the necessary inputs and equipment to start and run a farm business.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Water is considered a distinct and critical factor in agriculture primarily because it is necessary for ________.
questions.explain: Water is a vital resource for plant growth, seed germination, dissolving soil nutrients, and sustaining the lives of farm animals.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: The factor of agricultural production that organizes, controls, and coordinates all other factors to achieve farm objectives is called ________.
questions.explain: Management (the entrepreneur or farm manager) brings together land, labour, water, and money, making critical decisions to ensure the farm succeeds.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: What is the ultimate reward for management (the entrepreneur) after combining all production factors and bearing the risks of the farm business?
questions.explain: Profit is the reward for management or entrepreneurship, earned for the risks taken and the successful coordination of the farm business.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which of the following describes a unique characteristic of 'Land' as a factor of production?
options: It can be easily manufactured in a factory
It is mobile and can be moved from city to city
Its supply is relatively fixed in nature
It depreciates entirely within a year
questions.explain: A fundamental characteristic of land is that its total supply is fixed and cannot be increased by human effort; it is immobile and indestructible.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: The money paid to hired agricultural workers for their physical and mental efforts on the farm is referred to as ________.
questions.explain: Labour is compensated through the payment of wages (for daily/casual work) or salaries (for permanent work).
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Family labour, which involves the farmer, his wives, and children working on the farm, is a primary feature of ________.
questions.explain: Subsistence or peasant farmers rely heavily on family labour because they usually operate on small scales and lack the money to hire commercial labour.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Agriculture Fundamentals & Soil Science
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies
